en: For the Chief Musician. By the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth.

zh: 可拉後裔的詩歌，交與伶長。調用女音。

p.src: 1  God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

en: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
u.src: 1  God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

p.src: 2  Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;

en: Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;
u.src: 2  Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;

p.src: 3  though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling. Selah.

en: though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling. Selah.
u.src: 3  though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling. Selah.

p.src: 4  There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.

en: There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.
u.src: 4  There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.

p.src: 5  God is within her. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.

en: God is within her. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.
u.src: 5  God is within her. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.

p.src: 6  The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice and the earth melted.

en: The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice and the earth melted.
u.src: 6  The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice and the earth melted.

p.src: 7  The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

en: The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
u.src: 7  The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

p.src: 8  Come, see the LORD’s works, what desolations he has made on the earth.

en: Come, see the LORD’s works, what desolations he has made on the earth.
u.src: 8  Come, see the LORD’s works, what desolations he has made on the earth.

p.src: 9  He makes wars cease to the end of the earth. He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear. He burns the chariots in the fire.

en: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth. He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear. He burns the chariots in the fire.
u.src: 9  He makes wars cease to the end of the earth. He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear. He burns the chariots in the fire.

p.src: 10  “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted on the earth.”

en: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted on the earth.”
u.src: 10  “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted on the earth.”

p.src: 11  The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

en: The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
u.src: 11  The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
